headline: Bitcoin Nears $78,000 Amid Fading Midterm Election Uncertainty
summary: Bitcoin climbed toward $78,000 in a V-shaped recovery as uncertainty surrounding U.S. midterm elections began to fade.
why: Cryptocurrencies often trade on macroeconomic sentiment and regulatory clarity, with political developments frequently serving as key catalysts for digital asset volatility.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin prices rose sharply as political uncertainty cleared.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: As midterm election uncertainty faded, investor confidence returned, driving a V-shaped recovery in the digital asset market.
